definitions.chunk: Root manual discourse-function/meaning unit; not acoustic, fixed-length or model-call unit.
definitions.length: Unicode non-whitespace characters of the preserved text, not tokens or speaking duration.
definitions.role: One primary manual functional label plus optional secondary roles; not F/E/T/N or CPU operation.
definitions.progress: Relation to preceding material in same topic; introduce does not imply source-supported truth.
definitions.sensitivity: Merge adjacent chunks of the same primary role within each preserved record; not a second independent review.

publication_scope: Aggregate counts and generic renderer/checker only; no source-specific text, boundaries or examples
